title: Why I still start with a pencil
excerpt: Before Blender, before the camera, there was a pencil. It's still where most of my ideas begin.

blocks.text:
Sample entry, written to show the design. Replace it with your own words in Pages CMS, or delete it.

I started drawing long before I opened any design software. A pencil is slow, and that's the point: it makes me look properly at light, shape and expression before I decide anything.

From paper to 3D

When I model a character or plan a shot, a quick sketch comes first. It tells me what matters in the frame, so the hours in Blender go into the right places.

The sketch is where the idea is still cheap to change.
